request.message:
Produce the complete Week 1 production digest for Nebula Drift (Vantage Nine Studios) as the whole document, replacing whatever is there. Use exactly this structure and content.

TITLE (Heading 1): Nebula Drift - Weekly Production Digest
STATUS LINE (bold, directly under the title): Week 1 · 2026-01-05 to 2026-01-11 · Phase: Pre-production
Below it, smaller grey text: Vantage Nine Studios · internal · standing document, edited in place every Monday

SECTION 'What changed' (Heading 2), as bullets, verbatim:
  - Art style exploration narrowed to two directions
  - Nav-mesh generation for the Drift Belt sector

SECTION 'What is at risk' (Heading 2), as a bordered table with a shaded header row and alternating row shading, columns Risk / Owner / Area / Severity / Trend:
  | Save-game format still unversioned | Dev H. | Engineering | Medium | steady |
  | Boss encounter difficulty untuned for controller | Ana F. | Design | Low | steady |
  | Outsourced character art slipping two weeks | Priya N. | Art | Medium | steady |

SECTION 'What is next' (Heading 2), as bullets, verbatim:
  - Stand up the automated build farm
  - Decide Wwise vs FMOD
  - Lock the art direction to one of the two candidates

SECTION 'Archive' (Heading 2), a bordered table with a shaded header row, columns Week / Dates / Shipped / Risks carried, newest first:
  | - | - | Digest opened. No prior weeks. | - |

Use the same visual style throughout: dark blue headings, a bordered table with a dark shaded header row and alternating light row shading.

response.response: ✅ I created the Week 1 production digest as a complete replacement document, matching the structure and content you specified.
